Transformation Organizations Combine to Unlock Greater Value and Innovation</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">NEW YORK (May 26, 2026) &#8212; S&#38;P Global (NYSE&#58; SPGI) announced today that Saugata Saha, President of S&#38;P Global Market Intelligence and Chief Enterprise Data Officer, has decided to leave the company to pursue another opportunity. Mr. Saha will remain with S&#38;P Global through July 30, 2026, to support transition. </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;Saugata is a respected leader and a valued member of our Executive Leadership Team. He leaves Market Intelligence and our Enterprise Data Organization in a position of strength, with clear momentum, and a solid foundation to build upon. I wish him continued success ahead,&#8221; said Martina Cheung, President and Chief Executive Officer of S&#38;P Global. &#8220;We expect to move quickly, and thoughtfully, as we evaluate and refine the leadership and structure for Market Intelligence.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Enterprise Data Organization (EDO) will move to become part of the Chief Technology &#38; Transformation Office, led by Firdaus Bhathena, S&#38;P Global Chief Technology &#38; Transformation Officer.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;We are excited to unify the Company&#8217;s data and technology capabilities under Firdaus,&#8221; added Cheung. &#8220;This will accelerate the integration of AI across our products, enhance efficiency and productivity, and drive innovation and greater value for customers.&#8221;</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The company reiterates its financial guidance for 2026.</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">About S&#38;P Global</font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">S&#38;P Global (NYSE&#58; SPGI) enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise and technology to make decisions with conviction.
